resources.string: Unlink the selected picture and sound
Clear the time range, then tap a part and long-press other parts to select them for Link.
Tap a part to select it, then long-press other video or audio parts to add them. Long-press again to remove a part from the selection.
Non-contiguous parts selected. Each video or audio sequence must meet edge to edge, without gaps or overlaps. Move the parts together with Snap, then try Link again.
The selected video and audio do not overlap in time. Move them to a shared interval before linking.
The shared time starts or ends inside a transition. Adjust or remove that transition before linking the intersection.
Video and audio cover different times. Split at %1$s and %2$s, then link the shared interval? The outside parts stay separate. Nothing is deleted or moved.
The timeline changed. Tap Link again to review the current selection.
Restore audio sync: the sound is %1$s seconds off its picture
Out of sync with its picture by %1$s seconds
